fields.label: Main Logo
fields.description: Primary logo shown in the navbar and throughout the app. Recommended: SVG or PNG, transparent background, min 200×60px.

fields.label: Login Page Logo
fields.description: Logo shown on the login screen. Recommended: PNG/SVG, transparent, min 300×100px.

fields.label: Navbar Logo Height (px)
fields.description: Maximum pixel height of the logo in the navbar.

fields.label: Application Name Override
fields.description: If set, replaces the default Frappe site name in the navbar brand.

fields.label: Browser Favicon
fields.description: Icon shown in the browser tab. Recommended: ICO or PNG, 32×32px or 64×64px.

fields.label: App Icon (Square)
fields.description: Square icon for bookmarks, home screens. Recommended: PNG, 512×512px, no transparency.

fields.label: PWA Icon 192px
fields.description: Required for Progressive Web App manifest. Exactly 192×192px PNG.

fields.label: PWA Icon 512px
fields.description: Required for Progressive Web App manifest. Exactly 512×512px PNG.

fields.label: Login Background Image
fields.description: Full-page background for the login screen. Recommended: JPG/PNG/WEBP, min 1920×1080px.

fields.label: Login Illustration / Side Image
fields.description: Decorative illustration on the login page. Recommended: SVG/PNG, transparent.

fields.label: Background Overlay Color
fields.description: Color tint applied over the login background image.

fields.label: Overlay Opacity (0–1)
fields.description: 0 = transparent, 1 = fully opaque.

fields.label: Loader Logo / Image
fields.description: Image shown while the app is loading. Recommended: SVG or transparent PNG, min 120×120px.

fields.label: Loader Animation (GIF/WEBP/SVG)
fields.description: Animated image for the loading screen. If set, overrides the spinner.

fields.label: Loader Background Color
fields.description: Background color of the loading splash screen.

fields.label: Spinner / Progress Color
fields.description: Color of the spinning indicator.

fields.label: Navbar-specific Logo
fields.description: If set, used in the navbar instead of the main logo. Useful for horizontal/dark variants.

fields.label: Override Navbar Logo Height (px)
fields.description: Only needed if the navbar logo needs a different height than the main logo setting.

fields.label: Email Header Logo
fields.description: Logo at the top of outgoing emails. Recommended: PNG, white/transparent bg, min 300×80px.

fields.label: Email Footer Logo
fields.description: Smaller logo in the email footer. Same format as header logo.

fields.label: Custom <head> HTML
fields.description: Raw HTML injected into <head>. Use for extra link/meta tags.

fields.label: Custom Branding CSS
fields.description: Additional CSS applied after all theme rules. Useful for per-brand fine-tuning.
